description: Type annotations and function signatures for PyTorch's autograd profiling and device management modules, along with enum definitions and class declarations related to profiling events and device types.

classes.name: DeviceType
classes.description: Enumeration of various device types supported by the profiler, including CPU, CUDA, XPU, and other specialized hardware.

classes.name: ProfilerEvent
classes.description: Represents a profiling event with methods to retrieve timing, memory usage, and other attributes related to a specific profiling marker.

classes.name: _KinetoEvent
classes.description: Represents a detailed kineto profiling event with comprehensive attributes such as device info, timing, shapes, and metadata.

classes.name: _ProfilerResult
classes.description: Contains a collection of profiling events and methods to manipulate profiling results, such as saving and retrieving events.

classes.name: SavedTensor
classes.description: Placeholder class representing a saved tensor's state, typically used in tensor hooks.

classes.name: CreationMeta
classes.description: Enum representing metadata about tensor creation context, such as whether it was created in custom functions or inference mode.

methods.name: _enable_profiler
methods.description: Enables the profiler with a given configuration and activities.

methods.name: _prepare_profiler
methods.description: Prepares the profiler for collection based on the configuration.

methods.name: _toggle_collection_dynamic
methods.description: Dynamically enables or disables collection of profiling data for specified activities.

methods.name: _disable_profiler
methods.description: Disables the currently active profiler and returns the profiling results.

methods.name: _profiler_enabled
methods.description: Checks if the profiler is currently enabled.

methods.name: _add_metadata_json
methods.description: Adds custom metadata information to the profiling output.

methods.name: _kineto_step
methods.description: Marks a step in kineto profiling.

methods.name: _get_current_graph_task_keep_graph
methods.description: Retrieves whether to keep the current graph task.

methods.name: _get_sequence_nr
methods.description: Gets the current sequence number for profiling events.

methods.name: kineto_available
methods.description: Checks if kineto profiling backend is available.

methods.name: _record_function_with_args_enter
methods.description: Records the entry of a function with arguments in the profiler.

methods.name: _record_function_with_args_exit
methods.description: Records the exit of a function with arguments in the profiler.

methods.name: _supported_activities
methods.description: Returns a set of supported profiler activities.

methods.name: _enable_record_function
methods.description: Enables or disables record function hooks.

methods.name: _set_empty_test_observer
methods.description: Sets an empty test observer with optional sampling probability.

methods.name: _push_saved_tensors_default_hooks
methods.description: Pushes default hooks for saving tensors.

methods.name: _pop_saved_tensors_default_hooks
methods.description: Pops the default hooks for saving tensors.

methods.name: _top_saved_tensors_default_hooks
methods.description: Returns the current default hooks for saved tensors.

methods.name: _unsafe_set_version_counter
methods.description: Sets version counters for tensors in an unsafe manner.

methods.name: _enable_profiler_legacy
methods.description: Enables the legacy profiler with a given configuration.

methods.name: _disable_profiler_legacy
methods.description: Disables the legacy profiler and returns a list of events.

methods.name: _profiler_type
methods.description: Returns the current active profiler type.

methods.name: _saved_tensors_hooks_enable
methods.description: Enables hooks for saved tensors.

methods.name: _saved_tensors_hooks_disable
methods.description: Disables hooks for saved tensors with a message.

methods.name: _saved_tensors_hooks_get_disabled_error_message
methods.description: Retrieves the error message if hooks are disabled.

methods.name: _saved_tensors_hooks_set_tracing
methods.description: Sets whether saving tensors is being traced.

methods.name: _set_creation_meta
methods.description: Sets the creation metadata for a tensor.

methods.name: _get_creation_meta
methods.description: Gets the creation metadata for a tensor.
